headline: Adapt to changing timings and cues
intro_headline: Let the show respond to the moment.
problem: Live moments rarely follow a fixed schedule.
how_disguise_helps: Hold, trigger and synchronise cues in Designer. Operate graphics with Porta.
demo_instructions: Hold a cue or trigger the next.
result: The illustrative sequence advances every six seconds. Hold keeps the current cue in place until you release it or manually advance.
